Seminar in Quantum Algebra
Title: Fusion actions and categorical orbifold theoryAbstract: I will discuss our recent investigation into the generalized symmetries of condensable algebras in modular tensor categories. The mian results inculde Schur-Weyl duality, Galois correspondence and categorical orbifold theory. This is a joint work with Siu-Hung Ng， Li Ren and Feng Xu.
Speaker：Chongying Dong, University of California, Santa Cruz
